_meta.description: USD per 1M tokens, [input, output], keyed by model id. Loaded at proxy startup; changing a price = edit this file only, zero code change.
_meta.note: Standard (non-:batch) endpoint prices. The :batch variants are separate endpoints with different behavior — priced separately so a routed :batch slug is still billed accurately.
_meta.entry_format: model-id -> [input_per_m, output_per_m]; keys starting with '_' are metadata and ignored by the loader.
